events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey pipeline files, patches, git state and task T-154 record
events.input: $ ls -la workshop-plan/pipeline workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches 2>&1 | head -60; git log --oneline -5; git status --short workshop-plan/pipeline workshop-plan/bugs workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches | head; wc -l workshop-plan/pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md workshop-plan/pipeline/dash.py workshop-plan/bugs/pipeline.py; git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check memory rules on Usetantra repos, publish hold, and pilot PR states (read-only)
events.input: $ grep -n "T-154\|Usetantra\|2026-10-11" /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/MEMORY.md | head -15; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; gh pr list -R Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2 --state all --limit 12 --json number,state,title,createdAt,closedAt,mergedAt 2>&1 | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pitch doc, list backend patches, show PR time cache, scan for long dashes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan && cat pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md; ls -la tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2; cat pipeline/prs.json; LC_ALL=C grep -n $'\xe2\x80\x94\|\xe2\x80\x93' pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md tantra-product-patches/README.md | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run dashboard test and outline dash.py and bug pipeline code
events.input: $ python3 pipeline/test_dash.py 2>&1 | tail -8; grep -n "def \|overdue\|not merged yet\|no data yet\|day_only\|precision\|LIMIT" pipeline/dash.py | head -70; grep -n "def \|opened\|precision\|day_only\|isoformat\|strftime" bugs/pipeline.py | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the rest of the pitch doc and the PR refresh and ingest code
events.input: $ sed -n 22,78p pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | cut -c1-900; echo ----; sed -n 43,86p pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-260; echo ----; sed -n 112,128p bugs/pipeline.py | cut -c1-240

events.name: Bash
events.head: List backend patches, read patches README, PR cache and bugs directory
events.input: $ ls -la tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2; sed -n 1,60p tantra-product-patches/README.md | cut -c1-400; cat pipeline/prs.json | head -30; ls bugs | head -20

events.input: $ sed -n 43,86p pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-230; echo ----; sed -n 47,57p bugs/pipeline.py | cut -c1-200; sed -n 112,128p bugs/pipeline.py | cut -c1-220; echo; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the pre-merge and preview patch, the collect code, red-suite patch file list, Docker state and clone revision
events.input: $ cat tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/ci_premerge-and-preview--f0b901e.patch | cut -c1-220; echo ----; sed -n 76,110p bugs/pipeline.py | cut -c1-230; echo ----; grep -c . tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/fix_red-suites--f0b901e.patch; grep -n "^+++ \|^--- " tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/fix_red-suites--f0b901e.patch; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo DOCKER_UP || echo DOCKER_DOWN; ls ~/Documents/GitHub/ | head; git -C ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2 rev-parse --short origin/development HEAD 2>&1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the ship rate band code and the text of the served dashboard band
events.input: $ sed -n 138,192p pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-330; echo ----; curl -s -m 10 "http://localhost:8899/pipeline?v=verify1" | python3 -c "
